name: Jianzhe Chai

biography: My primary research interests are data contamination, AI security, and embodied AI safety.

I am a PhD student in Sakuma Lab at the Institute of Science Tokyo and a Research Associate in the AI Security and Privacy Team at RIKEN AIP. I also work as a part-time Research Assistant at the Institute of Science Tokyo, where I completed my M.S. in September 2026.
I received my B.Eng. in Software Engineering from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC) in June 2024.

news.text: I joined the AI Security and Privacy Team at RIKEN AIP as a Research Associate.
I began my PhD in Sakuma Lab at the Institute of Science Tokyo.
Our paper, When Benchmarks Leak: Inference-Time Decontamination for LLMs, appears in the ACL main conference.

publications.title: When Benchmarks Leak: Inference-Time Decontamination for LLMs
publications.summary: We introduce DeconIEP, an inference-time framework that reduces the influence of benchmark memorization using small, bounded perturbations in the input embedding space. It preserves the evaluation set while targeting contamination-driven performance inflation.
